items.title: Tom Lellis interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, July 31, 2007
items.q: I got to open for Bill Evans where I met Eddie Gomez and subsequently recorded with him later

ctx.x: I have, both of them, yeah. There was a great club in Cleveland that we would open for many acts, and I got to open for Bill Evans where I met Eddie Gomez and subsequently recorded with him later, and Jimmy Smith and so they all came through, and six nights, and we got to hear them. So everybody came through: Miles and McCoy and Keith Jarrett and the first version of Weather Report.
